name: Audio / DSP Engineer
description: Process audio signals, implement filters, FFT, and real-time audio pipelines. Build synthesizers, effects, and analysis tools.
dictum_features: Raw handle to T for audio buffers
example_snippet:
program SineWave:
    keep SampleRate as whole number with value 44100
    keep Frequency as fractional number with value 440.0
    keep Duration as whole number with value 1
    keep NumSamples as whole number
    put the product of SampleRate and Duration into NumSamples

    keep Buffer as raw handle to fractional number with room for the product of NumSamples and 8

    unsafe:
        keep Ptr as * fractional number
        put transmute Buffer as * fractional number into Ptr

        repeat NumSamples times using I:
            keep T as fractional number
            put the quotient of I and SampleRate into T
            keep Sample as fractional number
            put call dictum_math_sin with the product of the product of 6.28318 and Frequency and T into Sample
            put Sample into Index at I of Ptr
        end repeat
    end unsafe

    print the text "Generated " and NumSamples and " samples at 440Hz" and newline
end program
